summary: Inspected all retained derived responsive renders at 1440, 1280, 1024, 768, 390 and 375 px, verified their recorded document overflow, and traced the failing 375 px overflow to a page-owned related-product cart label/control.
issues: PRI-RESP-001 | high | horizontal overflow/control clipping at 375 px | expected: no document-level horizontal overflow and all page-owned purchase controls contained within the 375 px viewport | actual: responsive-375.json records 14 px overflow; the related-product 'Dodaj do koszyka' text/control begins at x=293.25, is 94.671875 px wide and reaches x=387.921875, visibly clipping the right-side card/control; the corresponding 390 px render has zero document overflow but only about 2 px containment margin | fix: make the page-owned related-products cards and add-to-cart controls wrap/stack within their section at narrow widths and verify scrollWidth equals viewport width at 375 px.

PRI-RESP-002 | medium | responsive related-products layout | expected: the two source-backed related products remain legible, proportionate cards with usable controls across the retained widths | actual: from 1440 through 375 px the page-owned related products render as extremely narrow, spatially scattered cards with large unused gaps, and at mobile widths headings wrap independently from the cards | fix: define a responsive two-column/one-column card layout scoped to product-related and verify card image, title, price and button alignment at every retained width.
